codename: The Lazy Loading & Wake Word Update
title: Lazy Loading, Social Tab Optimization & Experimental Wake Word
summary: This update focuses on resource management, significantly reducing system overhead through deferred rendering, while introducing the foundational architecture for hands-free voice activation.

sections.title: Added & New Features
items: Added Tab Loading Placeholder Text to provide clean visual feedback while heavier modules initialize in the background.
Integrated the experimental 'Visar' wake word utilizing the openwakeword library for hands-free activation.

sections.title: Improvements & System Redux
items: Implemented global lazy loading and deferred rendering across all main application tabs to significantly accelerate initial startup times.
Refactored the architecture of all 9 embedded boxes within the Social Tab to maintain a strictly low footprint on both CPU and RAM.
Updated the Neural Feed background styling to better align with the system's futuristic visual identity.
Enhanced the design and interactive hitboxes for the Settings and Full Screen buttons within the Social Tab.

notes: The newly integrated wake word engine is currently marked as Experimental/Unstable. Future patches will focus on acoustic tuning and thread stabilization to ensure reliable hands-free operation.
